p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    objs = {}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v = grid[r][c]
            if v:
                objs.setdefault(v, []).append((r,c))
    # Read components in their original left-to-right order.
    ordered = sorted(objs, key=lambda v: min(c for r,c in objs[v]))
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    base_r = base_c = 0
    for i,v in enumerate(ordered):
        cells=objs[v]
        minr=min(r for r,c in cells); minc=min(c for r,c in cells)
        oh=max(r for r,c in cells)-minr+1
        ow=max(c for r,c in cells)-minc+1
        if i==0:
            dr=dc=0
        elif i==1:
            ph,pw=prev_dims
            dr,dc=ph-1,pw-1
        else:
            dr=dc=1
        base_r += dr; base_c += dc
        for r,c in cells:
            rr=base_r+r-minr; cc=base_c+c-minc
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: out[rr][cc]=v
        prev_dims=(oh,ow)
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
